'''H.F. Marigand''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who worked for [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As Section Controller J506, Marigand submitted a [[Imperial security risks report|classified report]] for the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]], [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]], outlining unresolved security risks posed to the Empire, among which he named [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] deserters from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] of the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' who had worked with the Grand Army's [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-Mandalorian [[Bardan Jusik]], and the missing [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]].

==History==
H.F. Marigand was an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who worked in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the time shortly after it's [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Marigand held the position of Section Controller J506 within the intelligence organization, during which time the officer submitted a [[Imperial security risks report|classified report]] to the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]], [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]], detailing a number of threats to the security of the Empire that still existed following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], along with his recommendations as to how best to deal with them. Among the threats outlined in the report, Marigand named the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] deserters of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]]—specifically the six [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]], [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|Alpha-class ARC troopers]] [[Maze (clone trooper)|Maze]] and [[Sull]], and several [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Squad/Legends|squads]]—along with the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] responsible for training the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] and who had continued to work with the Republic's [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] throughout the war. Marigand also noted the former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bardan Jusik]] as a potential threat, due to his departure from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to become a Mandalorian, and the former [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]],<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> who had disappeared from Republic [[Valorum Center|custody]] during [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Officer H.F. Marigand respected the prowess of the Null and Alpha-class ARC troopers, regarding them as high-level dangers to the young Empire and remarking upon the Alpha ARCs' reputation as "one-man armies" in a report to Armand Isard, the Director of Imperial Intelligence. Marigand was also concerned by the prospect of a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|using]] Mandalorian, a threat embodied by the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Bardan Jusik, though Marigand believed Jusik had become a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] when in fact he had not. Marigand also advocated a strike at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gibad/Legends|Gibad]], both as a warning to other planetary governments who wished to dissent in the face of the new Empire, and a deterrent against aiding Gibadan native Ovolot Qail Uthan in her research into the [[FG36]] [[nanovirus]] [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]].<ref name="ImpCom501st" />
